svg.title: three-identical-vlm-stacks-side-by-side-differing-in-trainable-modules-with-captions
svg.desc: three identical bottom-up stacks side by side (ViT, V-L Connector, Word Emb., one attention block in a heavy rounded frame, LM Head), modules blue with pale-green dotted halos when trainable and grey when frozen, the third stack marked with dashed rectangles and blue dots, captions (a) LayerNorm, (b) QV Proj. / MLP, (c) LoRA under them | source: iclr24-0098_fig1 (iclr24-0098_fig1_p2_vector.svg) | candidate wave1:three-identical-vlm-stacks-side-by-side-differing-in-trainable-modules-with-captions | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
